Generated by `node scripts/update-firmware-facts.mjs` from the FW-V1 vendored corpus; never edit by hand. The images are not in this repository — these derived facts are, which is what lets `firmware-facts.test.ts` hold the profile tables to them everywhere, including where the corpus is absent.
